title: New Features for the Klaviyo App for ChatGPT: AI Marketing Optimization - Klaviyo
summary: The Klaviyo app for ChatGPT delivers real-time marketing intelligence and AI-driven automation wherever you work. Check performance, analyze anomalies, and get strategic actions instantly.
body_markdown:
Klaviyo performance insights inside ChatGPT


Generated by Klaviyo AI


The updated Klaviyo plugin for ChatGPT adds a pinned sidebar dashboard and suggested prompts for exploring campaign and flow performance. Marketers can view real-time metrics, investigate results, and receive recommendations based on their Klaviyo data across desktop, web, and mobile.


-


**Sidebar dashboard:** An interactive dashboard shows campaign and flow totals, top performers by revenue, and date-range performance with drill-downs.


-


**Suggested prompts:** Built-in prompts help marketers analyze flows, compare email and SMS results, and summarize performance.


-


**Deeper analysis:** One-click analysis reveals metric comparisons, segment performance, anomalies, and flow drop-off points.


-


**Data-based recommendations:** Follow-up questions generate suggestions for segmentation, subject lines, send windows, and other optimizations based on Klaviyo data.


[Sign up](https://www.klaviyo.com/sign-up)[Get a demo](https://www.klaviyo.com/demo-request)


---


Marketing is undergoing its most profound shift since the smartphone era. Conversational AI is becoming a new surface for discovery, decision-making, and soon, commerce itself. As people increasingly turn to tools like ChatGPT to ask what to buy, which brands to trust, or how to make sense of information, their expectations around how technology should work are changing, too.


Marketers feel this shift twice. First as consumers, and again in their day-to-day roles. The more they rely on conversational AI in their personal and professional lives, the more they expect every tool they use to work the same way: fast, intuitive, and responsive in natural language. That shift is reshaping what marketers want from their technology, and it’s why Klaviyo is bringing its intelligence directly into the conversational tools they already use.


Today, we’re excited to announce an update to the[Klaviyo plugin for ChatGPT](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai) , now listed in[ChatGPT’s plugin directory](https://openai.com/business/plugins/klaviyo/) with a performance dashboard pinned to your sidebar and suggested prompts to get you started. It is a new way for marketers to access, understand, and act on their Klaviyo data directly inside a conversational AI environment. This launch builds on Klaviyo’s early investment in the AI ecosystem, including our adoption of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which enables brands to connect their data to natural-language interfaces wherever they work.


“The Klaviyo plugin for ChatGPT brings the power of your customer data directly into the places you already work,” says Andrew Bialecki, Klaviyo’s Co-Founder and Co-CEO. “It lays the foundation for deeper capabilities—from campaign creation to real-time customer insights—all through natural conversation.”


> The Klaviyo app for ChatGPT brings the power of your customer data directly into the places you already work.


Andrew Bialecki Co-Founder and Co-CEO, Klaviyo


With the Klaviyo plugin for ChatGPT, we’re moving marketing toward a truly conversational way of working, one that is fluid, intuitive, and connected to the same real-time consumer insights marketers rely on every day in Klaviyo. It’s a meaningful step toward the next interface of marketing: a continuous conversational loop where insight, creativity, and action live together.


## **Your Klaviyo dashboard now lives in the ChatGPT sidebar**


Tagging @Klaviyo in any chat still works. The plugin adds a faster way in: Klaviyo is pinned to your ChatGPT sidebar, so your key numbers are one click away.


### **Check performance from the sidebar**


Open Klaviyo from the sidebar to see an interactive dashboard with:


- Campaign and flow totals
- Top-performing campaigns and flows by revenue
- Performance by date range, with drill-downs into specific campaigns and flows


Spot a flow that’s slipping, and you can ask Klaviyo about it right from the sidebar. The dashboard works across ChatGPT on desktop, web, and mobile, so you can check last night’s flow revenue from your phone before your first meeting.


### **Start with a suggested prompt**


The plugin comes with suggested prompts, so your first question is already written. Try:


- **“Analyze my replenishment flow and make recommendations for improvements.”**
- **“Compare email and SMS campaigns for the last 30 days with the previous 30 days.”**
- **“Summarize email and SMS performance for the last 30 days and call out the biggest wins and misses.”**


From there, you get the same interactive tables, one-click analysis, and recommended next steps covered below, all built on your Klaviyo data.


## The next interface of marketing is here


Marketers have been conditioned to seek answers inside their tools by opening a reporting dashboard, running a query, or exporting a spreadsheet. Then, they often require a data analyst to parse and interpret the data.


Conversational interfaces like ChatGPT have changed that forever.


ChatGPT has become the place where strategists draft briefs, plan campaigns, revise copy, and ask quick questions. But until now, those conversations have been disconnected from real first-party performance data. The Klaviyo ChatGPT app closes that gap.


With the app, marketers can:


- Ask in plain language how campaigns and flows are performing
- View real Klaviyo data returned as interactive cards and tables
- Click into deep-dive analytics for any campaign or flow
- Get plain-language insights and recommended next steps
- And soon, create complete Klaviyo campaigns directly from ChatGPT


We built the Klaviyo app for ChatGPT for the way marketers already use AI, designing it to make their Klaviyo data accessible and actionable wherever they prefer to work.


## Real-time campaign and flow performance in ChatGPT


Our first release focuses on what marketers told us they need most: fast visibility into performance and the ability to go deeper without opening a dashboard or switching tools.


Now, marketers can use the Klaviyo app in ChatGPT to view and analyze the performance of their campaigns and flows instantly, wherever they are. And because ChatGPT is accessible across devices, this effectively unlocks mobile access to key Klaviyo insights for the first time, giving marketers real-time visibility even on the go.


### Ask ChatGPT how your campaigns or flows are performing


Ask @Klaviyo in ChatGPT,: **“How are my campaigns performing this week?”** or **“Show me flow performance from the last seven days.”**


And you’ll immediately see:


- Campaign performance tables
- Flow performance tables
- Send status
- Delivered counts
- Open and click rates
- Conversion rate
- Attributed revenue


All displayed as interactive, mobile-friendly cards right inside ChatGPT.


### Insights and analysis in one click


Instead of navigating multiple dashboards, you get clarity in a single conversational thread. Tap Analyze on any table or row, and the app surfaces a complete deep-dive analysis, including:


- KPIs and metric comparisons vs. previous sends or historical benchmarks
- Micro-insights (e.g., “CTR dipped 4% vs. prior sends: test a shorter subject line”)
- Segment performance or cohort over-indexing
- Highlighted opportunities or anomalies


Flow analysis includes:


- Step-by-step performance
- Entry rate trends
- Drop-off points
- Daily or weekly revenue
- Suggested optimizations


### Get instant follow-up recommendations


After reviewing the performance, simply ask: **“Klaviyo, what should I do next?”**


And ChatGPT will suggest next steps based on your Klaviyo data, like:


- Whether to resend, segment, or optimize
- Follow-up email recommendations
- Subject line ideas
- Optimal send windows
- Audience or cohort suggestions


It’s the fastest path from insight → action.


## A new era of conversational marketing


Marketing has always been a conversation, one between a brand and its customers, data, and team ideas. With the Klaviyo ChatGPT app, analyzing and optimizing your marketing becomes a conversation, too.


No dashboards. No digging. No delays. Just real insights, delivered instantly, in the platform where you already think, plan, and create. But this is only the beginning. The Klaviyo ChatGPT app lays the groundwork for a world where:


- Insights and actions happen in a single thread
- Campaigns are generated from a simple prompt
- Audience intelligence appears instantly without filters or exports
- AI agents collaborate with your team, informed by customer behavior and performance


This is the early stage of the autonomous CRM: marketers define the goals, and AI accelerates the path to action. Klaviyo becomes the intelligence layer powering the next era of commerce.


The future of marketing is conversational, and it’s here today.


**Try the Klaviyo app in ChatGPT now or[browse apps from your ChatGPT sidebar](http://chatgpt.com/apps) .**


Ellen Bechtel


Ellen is a senior product designer on the AI and Analytics team at Klaviyo, with a focus on data experiences, visualization, and storytelling. Before landing in the design world, she was a data journalist for the US Geological Survey, a climate science communicator, a bike mechanic, and general contractor––all of which might explain her fondness for understanding systems, fixing things, and making technical stuff feel approachable. She loves working where creativity meets technicalities and gray areas, and has strong opinions about using AI in ways that actually help people (not just bolting it on willy-nilly).
